sentences.en: This is Kate.
sentences.zh: 这个是 Kate。

sentences.en: She went up the net.
sentences.zh: 她去向上这网。

sentences.en: "I like this," she said.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个， 她说。

sentences.en: She went on the slide.
sentences.zh: 她去在……上这滑行。

sentences.en: "I like this," she said.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个， 她说。

sentences.en: She went up the ladder.
sentences.zh: 她去向上这梯子。

sentences.en: "I like this," she said.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个， 她说。

sentences.en: "We like this," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢这个， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: The' and 'this' To help the child remember two common words.
sentences.zh: 这' 和 '这个' 到帮助这孩子记得二常见的单词。

sentences.en: Open the book at one of the double pages.
sentences.zh: 打开这书在一的这供两者用的页。

sentences.en: Ask the child to find 'the' or 'this' on the page.
sentences.zh: 问这孩子到找到 '这' 或者 '这个' 在……上这页。

sentences.en: When the child has found the word, ask them to close the book and spell the word.
sentences.zh: 当……时这孩子有找到这单词， 问他们到关上这书和咒语这单词。

sentences.en: • The child then asks you to find 'the' or 'this' on a page.
sentences.zh: • 这孩子然后问你到找到 '这' 或者 '这个' 在……上一个页。

sentences.en: You close the book and spell the word Have two or three turns each.
sentences.zh: 你关上这书和咒语这单词有二或者三转动每个。

sentences.en: You can use this idea straight away, or on another day.
sentences.zh: 你能使用这个主意直的离开， 或者在……上另一个一天。

sentences.en: • Practise spelling words the child has already learned, such as 'in', 'at', 'on", 'is", 'up', 'he', 'and'.
sentences.zh: • 练习拼写单词这孩子有已经学习， 这样的像 '在……里'， '在'， '在……上， '是， '向上'， '他'， '和'。

sentences.en: Give the child a lot of praise for spelling words correctly.
sentences.zh: 给这孩子一个许多的称赞为了拼写单词正确地。

sentences.en: Find everything Kate said.
sentences.zh: 找到一切 Kate 说。

sentences.en: Notice that the words she says have speech marks around them.
sentences.zh: 布告那个这单词她说有说话能力斑点在……周围他们。

sentences.en: Show the child how to read what Kate says in a different voice from the rest of the story.
sentences.zh: 展示这孩子如何到读什么 Kate 说在……里一个不同的说话声从这休息的这故事。
